findings.evidence: MediaRecorder import is used solely for the MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC audio source constant in AudioRecord. No video recording or transmission logic exists in the codebase.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. No user video data is recorded or transferred.

findings.evidence: In App.kt (lines 115-144), user tap on mic FloatingActionButton triggers audioRecorder.startRecording() and streams base64 audio chunks via LiveApiClient WebSocket to backend. As a user-initiated first-party transfer for AI Assistant voice interaction, prominent disclosure is exempt, but collection must be declared in Play Store Data Safety form.
findings.recommendation: Declare Audio collection for App Functionality in the Play Store Data Safety Section.

findings.evidence: AuthHelper.kt defines getCurrentUserUid() referencing FirebaseAuth currentUser UID. The UID is not transmitted to any custom off-device sinks or third-party endpoints.
findings.recommendation: No action required. User account UID is not transferred off-device.
